changes: Prepare absolute targets and headers when requests register, preserving queued and streamed body bytes.
Validate and snapshot proxy URLs, TLS options and headers; preserve zero and empty values; normalize reserved header decisions case-insensitively.
Bind origin-form paths to the requested destination, preserving double slashes, dot segments and escapes without Host-header rerouting.
Bound TCP/TLS establishment and destroy pending connections on cancellation, timeout or agent destruction.
Redact credentials from diagnostic events and logs; verify TLS before signaling proxy readiness.
Use two VPM dependencies; explicitly reject unused automatic Negotiate/onProxyAuth options rather than silently ignoring them.
upstreamTestAdaptations: Set the HTTPS fixture URL protocol explicitly for async-listen on Bun; applied equally to upstream and VPM.
